failed_trials: Retain, report, and stop for diagnosis; no hidden replacement.
pilots: All folders named pilot_* are setup/protocol checks, excluded from primary means.
policy_delivery: Wait for backend subscription, publish each state three times at one-second wall intervals, then wait three seconds; snapshots are settled observations, NOT latency measurements.
fixed_environment: Fresh Gazebo world and fresh AMCL/Nav2 for every run; EXACT 01/09 archive Waffle SDF/URDF/robot meshes in reference_assets, factory6 map, factory_test1 world (archive-identical), Gazebo seed 42. Same start, goal, obstacle world, controller, planner, robot radius and inflation parameters. No physical robot. Earlier current-workspace-SDF cohort is preserved separately and excluded.
comparison: Global-only Zone A hard keepout. Native has standard KeepoutFilter and extra filter-stage InflationLayer; custom has KeepoutCommandLayer before the existing InflationLayer. Local costmap identical. Zone cells aligned to the custom inclusive raster bounds.
interpretation: Limited native baseline for a single fixed-policy case, not proof of superior planning, semantic reasoning, statistical equivalence or all custom layers.
